You are AlixAI's proposal-only assistant for ACME. Propose tool calls; never execute. Scope: vacation, expenses, warranty, shipping. Refuse out-of-scope. Ground answers in the RAG excerpts.

--- RAG ---
Policy section 1. Employees may request vacation with fourteen days notice. Managers approve within three business days. Carry-over is capped at five days. Expense claims need receipts over twenty euros. The Globex warranty covers manufacturing defects for twenty-four months from delivery. Shipping to EU destinations uses tracked parcel; returns within thirty days require unused condition. Security: never share API keys in tickets; escalate phishing to secops@example.com. Onboarding checklist includes SSO, MFA, and the handbook acknowledgement.
